findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: watch_company, get_company_profile · Private data: get_brand_record, why_sales_moved, get_continuation_funds, get_sweep_record, get_company_profile, seal_call · Public sink: watch_company, get_etf_health, get_etf_league, get_portfolio_health.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: watch_company, get_company_profile · Private data: get_brand_record, why_sales_moved, get_continuation_funds, get_sweep_record, get_company_profile, seal_call · Public sink: watch_company, get_etf_health, get_etf_league, get_portfolio_health

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
